settings.general.language.label: Language
settings.general.language.desc: Interface language — more languages coming via community translation
settings.general.tray.label: Close to system tray
settings.general.tray.desc: Closing the window hides Melo in the system tray instead of quitting it. The tray icon is always available while Melo runs.
settings.playback.resume.label: Resume playback on reopen
settings.playback.resume.desc: Continue playback of the previous track where you left off
settings.playback.replaygain.label: ReplayGain normalization
settings.playback.fadepause.label: Fade out on pause
settings.playback.fadepause.desc: Smooth 0.5s fade-out on pause, fade back in on resume
settings.playback.crossfade.label: Crossfade & gapless
settings.playback.crossfade.desc: Smooth transitions between tracks: blend them with a crossfade, or set the length to 0 for gapless playback
settings.playback.crossfadeDuration.desc: How long the crossfade lasts (1–12 seconds). 0 = Gapless: no fade and no gap between tracks
settings.general.lyricsSkinLine.label: Show current lyric line in skins
settings.general.lyricsSkinLine.desc: Shows the active synced lyric line in skins that have a current-lyric slot. Skins without one are unaffected. The features of the selected skin are listed under Settings → Appearance & Skin.
settings.general.lyricsSkinLine.unsuppor: The selected skin does not support this feature.
settings.appearance.embeddedPlaylist.des: If the active skin includes a playlist slot, these control how it looks. Skins without this slot are unaffected.
settings.appearance.showstop.label: Show Stop button
settings.appearance.showstop.desc: Display a Stop control next to Play/Pause in the player
settings.visualizer.peak.label: Peak hold
settings.visualizer.peak.desc: Thin line above each column that falls slowly (classic EQ cap)
settings.visualizer.afterglow.label: Afterglow / trail
settings.visualizer.afterglow.desc: Fade the previous frame slightly — trace modes (e.g. Lissajous) come alive
settings.visualizer.bloom.label: Soft bloom
settings.visualizer.bloom.desc: Very slight glow on bar peaks
settings.visualizer.mirror.label: Mirror fade
settings.visualizer.mirror.desc: Very subtle reflection below the baseline
settings.visualizer.pale.label: Pale tops
settings.visualizer.pale.desc: Tall bars shift slightly to a paler color near the top
settings.visualizer.smoothing.label: Smoothing
settings.visualizer.smoothing.desc: How lively the bars follow the music — higher values react faster, lower values glide more smoothly
settings.reset.confirm.title: Reset all settings?
settings.reset.confirm.message: Preferences, theme, active skin, equalizer and visualizer settings return to their defaults. Your library, playlists and playback position are kept.
settings.visualizer.enabled.label: Enabled visualizers
settings.visualizer.enabled.desc: Uncheck modes you don't want — they disappear from the player's right-click list and the click cycle
settings.playback.smartPrev.label: Smart Previous
settings.playback.smartPrev.desc: If the track has been playing a while, the first press of Previous restarts it and a second press goes to the previous track. Off: Previous always goes to the previous track.
settings.appearance.waveformSeek.label: Waveform seek bar
settings.appearance.waveformSeek.desc: Shows the track's waveform instead of the plain progress bar, in skins that have a waveform slot. It is computed once per file in the background and cached; until then (or for unsupported formats such as Opus) the normal bar is shown.
settings.appearance.waveformSeek.unsuppo: The selected skin does not support this feature.
settings.appearance.waveformHover.label: Waveform hover preview
settings.appearance.waveformHover.desc: Shows a vertical line, the time under the pointer and lights up the waveform up to it while you hover.
settings.appearance.waveformBar.label: Waveform bar thickness
settings.appearance.waveformShape.label: Waveform shape
